body: **Combined check on the sprint 2 integration branch (orchestrator, 2026-10-04):** `scrum-cadence-s2` at `3e4c731` holds DM-30, DM-31 and DM-34. `npm run typecheck` passed, and `vitest` over core, integration, mcp, shared, main and renderer graph/checkpoint passed: 126 files, 3195 tests.
